description_en: Updates the name, description, chunking, or search configuration of a knowledge base. The metadataSchema, embeddingModel, and embeddingDimension cannot be modified after creation. The chunking configuration applies only to subsequently uploaded assets and does not implicitly rebuild existing assets
description_zh: 更新知识库的名称、描述、分块或检索配置。metadataSchema、embeddingModel 和 embeddingDimension 创建后不可修改。分块配置仅作用于后续上传的资产，不会隐式重建已有资产
name: UpdateKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID is resolved from the trusted gateway identity via Magic, and workspace ownership is verified. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace, and cannot be queried across tenants by using only the knowledge base ID
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. For retries on the same knowledge base with the same client token and identical update content, the accepted result is returned without further modifications. If the content differs, an IdempotencyConflict error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 可选。同一知识库上，相同 clientToken 和相同更新内容的重试返回已受理结果，不再次修改；内容不同返回 IdempotencyConflict
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, with a valid range of 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence splitting. Documents without headings fall back to intelligent splitting. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
fields.help_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验
fields.name: heading_level

fields.help_en: The maximum chunk size ranges from 1 to 6,000 characters. This follows the character length metric of EB, not the token count. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
fields.help_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值
fields.name: max_chunk_size

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, ensuring that the chunk size with overlap does not exceed the maximum chunk size. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
fields.help_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验
fields.name: overlap_size

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
fields.help_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址
fields.name: remove_urls_and_emails

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
fields.help_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格
fields.name: replace_consecutive_whitespace

fields.help_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before chunking
fields.help_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则
fields.name: preprocess_rules

fields.help_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. The delimiter is matched as a whole literal string without using regular expressions. This parameter is ignored for other strategies
fields.help_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略
fields.name: separator

fields.help_en: The saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates delimiter-based chunking. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for backward compatibility with historical configurations. Only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted when creating or updating configurations in the current phase
fields.help_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: The valid configuration with resolved default values. This configuration affects only subsequently uploaded or explicitly reprocessed assets
fields.help_zh: 已解析默认值的有效配置，仅影响后续新上传或显式重新处理的资产
fields.name: chunk_configuration

fields.help_en: The description of the knowledge base
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The updated name of the knowledge base
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: KEYWORD indicates keyword retrieval, VECTOR indicates vector retrieval, and HYBRID indicates hybrid retrieval. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, HYBRID is used
fields.help_zh: KEYWORD 为关键词检索，VECTOR 为向量检索，HYBRID 为混合检索。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 HYBRID
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: RRF indicates reciprocal rank fusion, and WEIGHTED indicates weighted normalized fusion. This parameter takes effect only in HYBRID mode. The system default is RRF
fields.help_zh: RRF 为倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 为加权归一融合。仅 HYBRID 生效，系统默认 RRF
fields.name: rank_algorithm

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable reranking. This applies to all three search modes. An explicit specification in the request overrides this configuration. If neither is configured, the value is false
fields.help_zh: 适用于三种检索模式；请求显式指定时覆盖本配置，均未配置时为 false
fields.name: rerank_enabled

fields.help_en: Supported models include qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. The request configuration takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, qwen3-rerank is used
fields.help_zh: 支持 qwen3-rerank、qwen3.7-text-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank；请求优先于本配置，均未配置时使用 qwen3-rerank
fields.name: rerank_model

fields.help_en: The k parameter for RRF. The system default is 60, and the value must be greater than 0
fields.help_zh: RRF 的 k 参数，系统默认 60，必须大于 0
fields.name: rrf_k

fields.help_en: The maximum number of results to return is 100. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, 10 is used. The actual number of results may be less than this value after permission and release version filtering
fields.help_zh: 最多返回 100 条。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 10；权限和发布版本过滤后可能不足该数量
fields.name: topk

fields.help_en: The vector path weight for WEIGHTED fusion. The system default is 0.7. The keyword path weight is 1 minus this value
fields.help_zh: WEIGHTED 的向量路权重，系统默认 0.7，关键词路权重为 1 减去此值
fields.name: vector_weight

fields.help_en: Updates the default search configuration at the knowledge base level, which takes effect immediately for subsequent search requests. If omitted, the configuration is not modified
fields.help_zh: 更新知识库级默认检索配置，立即对后续检索请求生效；省略表示不修改
fields.name: search_configuration

parameters.help_en: Provide at least one field to be updated. Unprovided fields remain unchanged. You can pass an empty string for the description field to clear the description, or omit it to keep the description unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 至少提供一项待更新字段；未提供的字段保持不变（其中 description 传空字符串可清空描述，省略不修改）
parameters.name: body

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The valid configuration with resolved default values. This configuration affects only subsequently uploaded or explicitly reprocessed assets
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析默认值的有效配置，仅影响后续新上传或显式重新处理的资产

headingLevel.description_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, with a valid range of 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the body text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence splitting. Documents without headings fall back to intelligent splitting. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: The maximum chunk size ranges from 1 to 6,000 characters. This follows the character length metric of EB, not the token count. If omitted, the server-side default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, ensuring that the chunk size with overlap does not exceed the maximum chunk size. This parameter is ignored for other strategies and is validated by the backend based on the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before chunking
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. The delimiter is matched as a whole literal string without using regular expressions. This parameter is ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: The saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates delimiter-based chunking. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for backward compatibility with historical configurations. Only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted when creating or updating configurations in the current phase
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

createdAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

embeddingDimension.description_en: The actual vector dimensions that take effect. Default value: 1024. It cannot be modified after creation
embeddingDimension.description_zh: 实际生效的向量维度，默认 1024，创建后不可修改

embeddingModel.description_en: The actual model name that takes effect. It cannot be modified after creation. Default value: text-embedding-v4
embeddingModel.description_zh: 实际生效的模型名称，创建后不可修改；默认 text-embedding-v4

enumValueTitles.qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash: 通义文本向量极速模型 3.7（qwen3.7-text-embedding-flash）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v3: 通义文本向量模型 v3（text-embedding-v3）
enumValueTitles.text-embedding-v4: 通义文本向量模型 v4（text-embedding-v4）

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable knowledge base ID generated by the platform. It is persistently bound to the tenant ID and workspace ID. Queries and modifications must verify all three identifiers simultaneously, and access based solely on the ID is not allowed
knowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 平台生成的稳定知识库 ID，持久化绑定 tenantId 和 workspaceId；查询和变更必须同时校验三者，不得仅凭 ID 访问

lastError.description_en: The sanitized error summary when a lifecycle operation fails
lastError.description_zh: 生命周期操作失败时的脱敏错误摘要

code.description_en: The stable product error code. It does not return internal task identifiers, stack traces, or storage addresses
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The sanitized error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadataSchema.description_en: The metadata field definitions determined during creation. They cannot be modified after creation and include constant or system variable configurations
metadataSchema.description_zh: 创建时确定，创建后不可修改；包含常量或系统变量配置

name.description_en: The metadata field name of the knowledge base in the workspace. It must be unique within the same schema and cannot occupy system control fields
name.description_zh: 工作空间内知识库的元数据字段名；同一 schema 中唯一，不得占用系统控制字段

type.description_en: The field type, such as STRING, LONG, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, or DATETIME. Uploaded and updated string values are parsed by the backend based on this type. Nested objects are not accepted
type.description_zh: STRING、LONG、DOUBLE、BOOLEAN 或 DATETIME。上传和更新的字符串 value 由后端按此类型解析；不接受嵌套对象

value.description_en: The fixed value or system variable name. It uses DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_URI, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME. DOCUMENT_* refers to the original asset in this operation, and the variable names retain EB compatibility
value.description_zh: 固定值或系统变量名。沿用 DOCUMENT_NAME、FILE_TYPE、FILE_SIZE、DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME、SOURCE_TYPE、SOURCE_URI、SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME；DOCUMENT_* 在本接口中指资产原件，变量名保留 EB 兼容性

valueMode.description_en: The value mode. CONSTANT indicates a constant: a fixed value is used when the value is not empty, and the value is assigned during upload if not configured. SYSTEM_VARIABLE indicates that the value is generated by the system and cannot be overwritten by customers. The schema cannot be modified after creation
valueMode.description_zh: CONSTANT 表示常量：value 非空时使用固定值，未配置值时由上传赋值；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 表示由系统生成，客户不得覆盖。schema 创建后不可修改

name.description_en: The display name of the knowledge base

regionId.description_en: The region where the knowledge base is located. It is consistent with the associated workspace and maintained by the server
regionId.description_zh: 知识库所在地域，与所属工作空间一致，由服务端维护

searchConfiguration.description_en: The valid search configuration with parsed platform default values. It can be overridden by a single search request
searchConfiguration.description_zh: 已解析平台默认值的有效检索配置，可由单次检索请求覆盖

mode.description_en: KEYWORD indicates keyword retrieval, VECTOR indicates vector retrieval, and HYBRID indicates hybrid retrieval. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, HYBRID is used
mode.description_zh: KEYWORD 为关键词检索，VECTOR 为向量检索，HYBRID 为混合检索。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 HYBRID

rankAlgorithm.description_en: RRF indicates reciprocal rank fusion, and WEIGHTED indicates weighted normalized fusion. This parameter takes effect only in HYBRID mode. The system default is RRF
rankAlgorithm.description_zh: RRF 为倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 为加权归一融合。仅 HYBRID 生效，系统默认 RRF

rerankEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable reranking. This applies to all three search modes. An explicit specification in the request overrides this configuration. If neither is configured, the value is false
rerankEnabled.description_zh: 适用于三种检索模式；请求显式指定时覆盖本配置，均未配置时为 false

rerankModel.description_en: Supported models include qwen3-rerank, qwen3.7-text-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. The request configuration takes precedence over this configuration. If neither is configured, qwen3-rerank is used
rerankModel.description_zh: 支持 qwen3-rerank、qwen3.7-text-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank；请求优先于本配置，均未配置时使用 qwen3-rerank

enumValueTitles.gte-rerank-v2: 通用文本重排模型 v2（gte-rerank-v2）

rrfK.description_en: The k parameter for RRF. The system default is 60, and the value must be greater than 0
rrfK.description_zh: RRF 的 k 参数，系统默认 60，必须大于 0

topK.description_en: The maximum number of results to return is 100. The request configuration takes precedence over the knowledge base configuration. If neither is configured, 10 is used. The actual number of results may be less than this value after permission and release version filtering
topK.description_zh: 最多返回 100 条。请求优先于知识库配置，均未配置时使用 10；权限和发布版本过滤后可能不足该数量

vectorWeight.description_en: The vector path weight for WEIGHTED fusion. The system default is 0.7. The keyword path weight is 1 minus this value
vectorWeight.description_zh: WEIGHTED 的向量路权重，系统默认 0.7，关键词路权重为 1 减去此值

status.description_en: You can call the GetKnowledgeBase and ListKnowledgeBases operations to query the creation progress. Creating indicates that the knowledge base is being created, Active indicates that the creation succeeded, and CreateFailed indicates that the creation failed. A deletion acceptance response may return Deleting, DeleteFailed, or Deleted. After a deletion is accepted, GetKnowledgeBase returns a resource not found error, ListKnowledgeBases no longer displays the resource, and the system continues to clean up the resource in the background. For the cause of a creation failure, see lastError
status.description_zh: GetKnowledgeBase 和 ListKnowledgeBases 可查询创建进度：Creating 为创建中，Active 为创建成功，CreateFailed 为创建失败。删除受理响应可返回 Deleting、DeleteFailed 或 Deleted；删除受理后 GetKnowledgeBase 返回资源不存在，ListKnowledgeBases 不再显示该资源，后台继续清理。创建失败原因见 lastError

tenantId.description_en: The read-only tenant to which the resource belongs. It is resolved by Magic based on the trusted gateway call identity and bound during creation. It must match the tenant of the associated workspace and cannot be specified or modified by the client
tenantId.description_zh: 只读租户归属，由 Magic 根据可信网关调用身份解析并在创建时绑定，与所属工作空间的租户一致；不接受客户端指定或修改

updatedAt.description_en: The time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The AgentCore workspace to which the resource belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
